title: clear button
rule: Display a trailing Clear control so people can erase the field without repeatedly tapping Delete.
pass_when: Filled text field shows a trailing Clear that empties that field.
fail_when: User can only erase by repeated Delete; no trailing Clear.
overview: Show a trailing Clear control so filled text can be erased in one action.
apply_when: Filled text fields where users may want to wipe the value quickly.
not_when: Empty fields or controls that are not text entry.
agent_hint: Add a trailing Clear that empties the filled text field in one tap.
description: A trailing Clear control lets people erase the field without repeatedly tapping Delete. Pass when a filled text field shows that Clear and it empties that field; fail when the only erase path is repeated Delete with no trailing Clear. Keep Clear tied to the single field it clears, not a whole-form reset. Use on filled text entry where one-tap wipe is useful; omit on empty fields.
